**What's the use case?**
What are you trying to do that the dashboard doesn't support today? (Not just the feature
itself — the "why" helps a lot, especially since this project is deliberately opinionated:
local-first, no cost/pricing columns, exact-vs-estimated always labeled.)

**What would you want to see?**
A rough sketch of the feature — a new page, a new stat, a new CLI command, etc.

**Anything else**
Alternatives you've considered, related issues, screenshots/mockups if you have them.
